//: The test programs, which the shipped package configs exclude. One config, not thirty: every package's tsconfig.json is composite, so dropping its `exclude` would emit each .test.ts into dist/. This one is noEmit + non-composite, so it typechecks the same files and writes nothing. Run by `bun run scripts/test-typecheck-gate.ts`, on a ratchet; it is not part of `tsc -b`.
